‌1. Core Character Design‌

‌Appearance‌: A 25-year-old celestial beauty with skin resembling mutton-fat jade, subtly translucent. Facial features include a defined yet soft bone structure, slightly prominent cheekbones, a straight nose bridge, and full petal-shaped lips in natural pink‌.
‌Expression‌: Almond-shaped eyes with amber-colored irises, long curled lashes, and a gaze blending mystery and detachment. A faint smile with regal composure‌.
‌Physique‌: 175cm height, swan-like neck, 58cm waist, legs with natural muscle definition, avoiding artificial retouching‌.
‌2. Costume Details‌

‌Main Dress‌:
‌Material‌: Outer layer of sheer silk organza, inner lining of matte satin to eliminate plastic shine‌.
‌Structure‌: Cross-collared robe with 0.5cm gold-threaded borders. A jade-green brocade belt (3cm wide) ties at the waist, attached with two 2-meter ribbons embroidered with miniature landscapes‌.
‌Embellishments‌: Graduated cyan-to-emerald skirt with 3D phoenix patterns in silver thread. 999 freshwater pearls (1mm each) adorning phoenix tail feathers‌.
‌3. Accessories‌

‌Headpieces‌:
Silver filigree hairpin with 9 South Sea pearls (8mm center pearl above the forehead)‌.
Gold-and-kingfisher-feather butterfly hairpins on temples, wings trembling with movement‌.
‌Jewelry‌:
18K gold earrings with icy jadeite drops (length reaching jawline), containing natural inclusions‌.
Choker necklace of 0.3mm gold filigree in lotus motifs, centered with a 5-carat Paraíba tourmaline‌.
‌Shoes‌:
Sculpted clear quartz shoes (7cm spiral heels), lambskin-lined, anti-slip engraved soles, and 18K gold cloisonné lotus at toes‌.
‌4. Scene & Photography‌

‌Environment‌:
Marble platform extending over clouds, wisteria vines cascading from edges‌.
Distant karst mountains with pine forests and waterfalls flowing into bioluminescent lotus ponds‌.
Floating peach-blossom petals and a leaf-shaped guqin with multicolored tassels in foreground‌.
‌Lighting & Techniques‌:
Golden-hour backlighting (3200K), softbox at 45° left (60% intensity), reflector on right. Apply 0.5-stop graduated ND filter to mountains‌.
Depth of field: f/2.8 aperture, focus on eyes, 15% foreground petal blur, 80% background mountain blur‌
